        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">gtsang nag pa</rs> na re | des la khyab pa nges byed kyi tshad mas rig tsam la rig pa phyi ma skyed nus te rig pa phyi ma thug med skyes nus kyis khyab pa × grub paM skad cig tsam | dang po ltar na bsgrub bya grub zin pas rtags don med la |  
        gnyis pa ltar na de brgya <pb n="9a"/><lb n="9a1"/> 'thud kyang skad cig brgya las med pas des de brtan par mi 'grub po || 'di ni rang rig mngon sum gyis thug pa mngon sum gyis thug pa dngos su khegs pas thug med du shugs la <note type="gloss">'</note>grub zer ro || 
        de dang 'thun par <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">dmyal pa</rs>s kyang ngo || </seg></TEI>
